an5.103:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhim pi chindati nillopam pi harati ekāgārikam pi karoti paripanthe pi tiṭṭhati.
an5.103:1.3: Idha bhikkhave mahācoro visamanissito ca hoti gahananissito ca balavanissito ca bhogacāgī ca ekacārī ca.
an5.103:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mahācoro visamanissito hoti? 3.
an5.103:2.2: Idha bhikkhave mahācoro nadīviduggaṃ vā nissito hoti pabbatavisamaṃ vā.
an5.103:2.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mahācoro visamanissito hoti.
an5.103:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mahācoro gahananissito hoti? 4.
an5.103:3.2: Idha bhikkhave mahācoro tiṇagahanaṃ vā nissito hoti rukkhagahanaṃ vā rodhaṃ vā mahāvanasaṇḍaṃ vā.
an5.103:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mahācoro gahananissito hoti.
an5.103:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mahācoro balavanissito hoti? 5.
an5.103:4.2: Idha bhikkhave mahācoro rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattānaṃ vā nissito hoti.
an5.103:4.4: ‘sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ime rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇissantī' ti.
an5.103:4.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tyāssa rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇanti.
an5.103:4.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mahācoro balavanissito hoti.
an5.103:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mahācoro bhogacāgī hoti? 6.
an5.103:5.2: Idha bhikkhave mahācoro aḍḍho hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo.
an5.103:5.4: ‘sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ito bhogena paṭisantharissāmī' ti.
an5.103:5.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tato bhogena paṭisantharati.
an5.103:5.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mahācoro bhogacāgī hoti.
an5.103:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mahācoro ekacārī hoti? 7.
an5.103:6.2: Idha bhikkhave mahācoro ekako niggahanāni kattā hoti.
an5.103:6.4: ‘Mā me guyhamantā bahiddhā sambhedaṃ agamaṃsū' ti.
an5.103:6.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mahācoro ekacārī hoti.
an5.103:7.1: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhim pi chindati nillopam pi harati ekāgārikam pi karoti paripanthe pi tiṭṭhati. 8.
an5.103:8.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an5.103:8.3: Idha bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu visamanissito ca hoti gahananissito ca balavanissito ca bhogacāgi ca ekacāri ca.
an5.103:9.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu visamanissito hoti? 10.
an5.103:9.2: Idha bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu visamena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, visamena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, visamena manokammena sammanāgato hoti.
an5.103:9.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu visamanissito hoti.
an5.103:10.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu gahananissito hoti? 11.
an5.103:10.2: Idha bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu micchādiṭṭhiko hoti antagāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato.
an5.103:10.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu gahananissito hoti.
an5.103:11.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu balavanissito hoti? 12.
an5.103:11.2: Idha bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattānaṃ vā nissito hoti.
an5.103:11.4: ‘sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ime rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇissantī' ti.
an5.103:11.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tyāssa rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇanti.
an5.103:11.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu balavanissito hoti.
an5.103:12.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu bhogacāgī hoti? 13.
an5.103:12.4: ‘sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ito lābhena paṭisantharissāmī' ti.
an5.103:12.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tato lābhena paṭisantharati.
an5.103:12.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu bhogacāgī hoti.
an5.103:13.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu ekacārī hoti? 14.
an5.103:13.2: Idha bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu ekako paccantimesu janapadesu nivāsaṃ kappeti.
an5.103:13.3: So tattha kulāni upasaṅkamanto lābhaṃ labhati.
an5.103:13.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu ekacārī hoti.
